title: lotononis stricta
intro: Lotononis stricta, commonly known as  the 'White Thorn', is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation, pain relief, and the treatment of fever, as well as its potential anti-diabetic and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotononis stricta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, among others. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
